policies.title: South Sudan ordinary passports: Bahamas visa-free leisure visits
policies.summary: The Bahamas' statutory rule requires a leisure-visitor visa only for citizens of the finite Second Schedule cohort; that schedule and the current Ministry list name Sudan but not the distinct state of South Sudan.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary South Sudan passport holder visiting The Bahamas for a short leisure stay.

The governing Regulations impose a visitor visa where the traveller is a citizen of a Second Schedule country or travels for education or employment. South Sudan is outside that finite designated-country cohort.
The Ministry's current April 2026 list independently repeats Sudan in the visa-required cohort without treating South Sudan as Sudan.
Education, employment, residence, special documents, carrier checks and final immigration admission remain outside this leisure-visitor baseline.

policies.title: South Sudan ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance short-stay visa
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's Foreigners Law requires a visa unless the passport state is in the closed exemption cohort, and the current decision does not exempt South Sudan; the normal Visa C is obtained before entry through a diplomatic-consular post.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary South Sudan passport holder travelling for tourism or another private short-stay purpose, normally up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
The traveller normally obtains Visa C before entry from a Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular post or an authorized treaty partner.
The exceptional border Visa C requires an unforeseeable urgent reason and proof that advance application was impossible; it is not a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route.
Qualifying residence documents, third-country-document exceptions, diplomatic or service passports, treaty exceptions, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-stay visa law and requirements
steps: Identify the competent Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular post or authorized treaty partner before travel.
Apply for Visa C with a valid passport, travel medical insurance and evidence of the visit's purpose and conditions.
Travel only after issuance and carry the required supporting documents for the final border-admission decision.
